usedFor: TallyPrime holds vouchers and notes, and Google Sheets keeps a running view through “Update Spreadsheet Row”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Purchase event occurs” in TallyPrime, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: A new purchase voucher in a chosen company updates a sheet row, so purchases show up outside the books.

watchOut: “New Delivery Note event occurs” also fires on updates, deletes and PDF saves, so the same note can run twice.
